blindWork: Permanganate half-reaction: MnO4^- + 8H+ + 5e- -> Mn2+ + 4H2O. The iron half-reaction is Fe2+ -> Fe3+ + e-, so balance electrons with 5 Fe2+. Full equation: MnO4^- + 5Fe2+ + 8H+ -> Mn2+ + 5Fe3+ + 4H2O.
stem:
Oxidation-Reduction: In the balanced redox reaction in acidic solution:

$$\text{MnO}_{4}^{-} + \text{Fe}^{2 +} + \text{H}^{+} \rightarrow \text{Mn}^{2 +} + \text{Fe}^{3 +} + \text{H}_{2}\text{O}$$

What is the stoichiometric coefficient for $\text{H}^{+}$ when the equation is balanced with smallest whole-number coefficients
sourceExplanation: Balanced equation: $5\text{Fe}^{2 +} + \text{MnO}_{4}^{-} + 8\text{H}^{+} \rightarrow 5\text{Fe}^{3 +} + \text{Mn}^{2 +} + 4\text{H}_{2}\text{O}$. Coefficient for $\text{H}^{+}$ is 8. Wait, let's balance carefully: $MnO_{4}^{-} + 8H^{+} + 5e^{-} \rightarrow Mn^{2 +} + 4H_{2}O$, coefficient is 8. (B)
